plan: Keep the authored recipe immutable: adapt() deep-copies the recipe into a working structure; print_original() returns authored_text unchanged, byte-for-byte.
Scale every ingredient quantity (main list and each component's list) by target_yield / original yield using fractions.Fraction; never touch a float or a units package.
For each ingredient whose name is excluded, select the substitution deterministically by minimal (priority, catalog index); apply name, quantity_factor, unit, and preparation changes.

Resolve substitutions as a chain: if the replacement (or an additional ingredient it introduces) is itself excluded, emit a warning and substitute again; a seen-set of names per chain detects cycles and yields 'substitution cycle involving NAME'.

Propagate each replacement to dependent text: record (old,new) name renames and explicit wording_changes, then apply them in order to all instruction strings (main and components); an ingredient's own preparation is auto-renamed when the result gives no explicit preparation, so no excluded name survives anywhere.

Track an equipment working set through add_equipment/remove_equipment; after all substitutions, every item not in available_equipment becomes an independent 'equipment NAME unavailable' reason; the adapted recipe's equipment is the sorted working set.

Accumulate reasons in a set so all independently applicable failures (missing substitution, cycle, unavailable equipment) are reported together, sorted; on failure return recipe=None while still reporting choices considered and sorted warnings.
Support an optional yield_factor on a substitution result by rescaling all quantities so the delivered recipe still meets the target yield, with a warning.

Ship an executable acceptance suite in __main__ covering: 3->5 scaling, chained substitution, verb+equipment-changing substitution, reintroduced exclusion via an additional ingredient, three simultaneous impossibility reasons, byte-exact original printing with input non-mutation, and priority/catalog-order determinism.
mechanisms: deep-copy working recipe preserving the authored original
Fraction-based rational yield scaling across main and component ingredient groups
deterministic substitution selection by (priority, catalog index) key
chained substitution resolver with per-chain seen-set cycle detection
ordered rename + wording-change rewrite pass over all instruction and preparation strings
equipment working set with post-substitution availability check
reason-set accumulation reporting every independent impossibility, sorted
yield_factor compensation keeping the adapted recipe at the requested target yield
